|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current version. The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-11.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-01.gif]], 1 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' ([[Jakku: Niima Outpost Shipyard]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-jakkuniimaoutpostshi022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Light)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your starfighters take off and land here for free.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): '''First published 31 May 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/hires/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-jakkuniimaoutpostshie8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Light)” → “Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Light)” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (490×353 → 745×534 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Light)”. It is the current image. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Your starfighters take off and land here for free.” This image was first published on 31 May 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/hires/jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
